result.instructions: Tools for Kixie, hosted by usefulapi.io. If the user is new or asks what this server can do, suggest requests such as: "Call Jo from our sales team and connect her to this lead's number."; "Which of our agents are logged in and free right now?"; "Send the team SMS to this customer from our main team number.". Read-only tools never change data; ask the user before a tool that creates, changes or deletes Kixie data. Free plan: 50 tool calls per month. Run kixie_usage_status to see the calls used this month. If the user asks for something none of these tools can do, tell the user and, with their OK, run kixie_request_feature to record the request. Paid plans: Pro (10,000 tool calls a month, $9/month or $90/year, for normal use) and Pro+ (100,000 tool calls a month, $39/month or $390/year, for automations and heavy use). A plan can be cancelled at any time and then runs to the end of the paid period, so it also suits a one-time job. When the user wants more calls or reaches the limit, run kixie_upgrade without a plan: it returns both plans, each with a payment link for the user to open. kixie_cancel_subscription cancels Pro at the end of the paid period.

tools.name: kixie_agent_status
tools.title: Get agent status
tools.description: Check whether a Kixie agent is logged in (registered) and whether they are on a live call. An offline agent returns success false with registered 0; that is a valid answer, not an error. Kixie Agent Status API: GET /www/agent/status.

email.description: Email of the Kixie agent (user) who places the call or sends the message.

tools.name: kixie_list_webhooks
tools.title: List webhooks
tools.description: List the event webhooks configured for this Kixie account (calls, SMS, dispositions, voicemail). Kixie webhook API: POST /app/v1/api/getWebhooks.

tools.name: kixie_make_call
tools.title: Make a call
tools.description: Start an outbound call. Kixie rings the agent first, then dials the target number once the agent answers. This places a real, billed call. Kixie Make a Call API: eventname call.

agent_email.description: Email of the Kixie agent (user) who places the call or sends the message.

target.description: Phone number in international format, for example +12025550123.

display_name.description: Label shown under the contact name in the dialer.

tools.name: kixie_send_sms
tools.title: Send an SMS
tools.description: Send one SMS from the agent's Kixie number to a phone number. The message is delivered and billed. Kixie Send SMS API: eventname sms.

agent_email.description: Email of the Kixie agent (user) who places the call or sends the message.

target.description: Phone number in international format, for example +12025550123.

tools.name: kixie_send_team_sms
tools.title: Send a team SMS
tools.description: Send a first Team SMS to a customer from a Kixie team number. Needs the Team SMS id from the Kixie dashboard (Manage > Numbers) and the Team SMS API enabled by Kixie support. Kixie Team SMS API: eventname bizsms.

team_sms_id.description: The Team SMS id from the Kixie dashboard.

target.description: Phone number in international format, for example +12025550123.

tools.name: kixie_send_to_queue
tools.title: Send to queue
tools.description: Ring an agent, then dial a contact from a Kixie queue. Queue ids are in the Kixie dashboard (Manage > Inbound > Queues). Kixie Send to Queue API: eventname queue.

agent_email.description: Email of the Kixie agent (user) who places the call or sends the message.

target.description: Phone number in international format, for example +12025550123.

queue_id.description: The queue id from the Kixie dashboard.

display_name.description: Label shown under the contact name in the dialer.

tools.name: kixie_remove_from_queue
tools.title: Remove from queue
tools.description: Remove one phone number from a Kixie queue. Kixie Remove From Queue API: eventname queue, action remove.

agent_email.description: Email of the Kixie agent (user) who places the call or sends the message.

target.description: Phone number in international format, for example +12025550123.

queue_id.description: The queue id from the Kixie dashboard.

display_name.description: Label shown under the contact name in the dialer.

tools.name: kixie_flush_queue
tools.title: Flush queue
tools.description: Remove ALL numbers from one Kixie queue for one user. This cannot be undone from this tool. Kixie Flush Queue API: POST /app/legacy/flushUserQueue, call flushUserQueue.

user_id.description: The Kixie user id that owns the queue.

tools.name: kixie_add_to_powerlist
tools.title: Add to powerlist
tools.description: Add a contact to a Kixie powerlist (a dialing list). duplicate_handling sets what happens when the number already exists; the Kixie example uses overwrite. Kixie Add to Powerlist API: eventname updatepowerlist.

powerlist_id.description: The powerlist id from the Kixie dashboard.

target.description: Phone number in international format, for example +12025550123.

duplicate_handling.description: What to do when the number already exists, for example overwrite.

tools.name: kixie_remove_from_powerlist
tools.title: Remove from powerlist
tools.description: Remove one or more phone numbers from one Kixie powerlist. Kixie Remove From Powerlist API: eventname removefrompowerlist.

powerlist_id.description: The powerlist id from the Kixie dashboard.

items.description: Phone number in international format, for example +12025550123.

targets.description: Phone numbers to remove from the powerlist.
